secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI-powered study plan analysis. Get it from Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Optional — app boots without it but AI features will be disabled.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL for avatar image storage. Get it from your Supabase project dashboard. Optional — app falls back to local storage without it.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role secret key for server-side storage operations. Get it from your Supabase project dashboard > Settings > API. Optional — app falls back to local storage without it.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: SMTP server hostname for sending emails (e.g. smtp.gmail.com). Optional — email features disabled without it.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASS
secrets.description: SMTP authentication password or app password. Optional.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for email delivery (alternative to SMTP). Get it from https://resend.com/api-keys. Optional.
